subject: Security questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2 status, scope and scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@carecore.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Security questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2 status, scope and scheduling

Hi Maya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can get SIG/CAIQ rolling: 

- SOC 2: You mentioned CareCore completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025; can you confirm the scope (Prod app + Data Platform or narrower)? Also would you be able to share the SOC 2 cover letter or auditor contact?
- Data categories: Confirm whether PHI is in-scope for the endpoints Redwood would touch (user profile vs. medical records).
- Questionnaire: We typically start with a CAIQ + a short custom addendum (cloud sharing, KV cache persistence). Would you prefer we send the CAIQ first or a prefilled form?
- Timeline & owners: Suggest a 2-week turnaround for a first pass; please share the best security contact(s) and an estimated availability window for a 30–45 minute kickoff next week.

I've attached a short ask-list and our standard CAIQ baseline for reference. Next steps proposed: 
1) CareCore sends SOC 2 scope confirmation + owner contact (Maya/Tom)
2) Redwood prefill CAIQ and return with clarifying questions within 48 hours
3) Joint kickoff call to review evidence drop and timing

Would Thursday 3/24 10:00–10:45 PT work for a kickoff? If not, propose two alternate windows.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Security once we have SOC scope confirmed.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: CareCore-SOC2-asklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), VendorSecurityQuestionnaire-CAIQ.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Maya Patel <m.patel@carecore.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carecore.io>, CareCore Security Team <security@carecore.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2 status, scope and scheduling

Thanks Vanessa — good summary. Quick answers while I pull the docs: 

- SOC 2 Type II (2025-06 to 2026-06) covers Production web service and our Kafka-backed data ingestion pipeline. It does NOT include the analytics sandbox (separate control scope).
- PHI: We store limited PHI elements (diagnosis codes and visit timestamps) in the production DB. PHI is encrypted at rest and in transit; access is restricted to a small set of services.
- Prefill: We prefer a short prefill from Redwood first so our team can review rather than filling a blank CAIQ.
- Owners: Tom Reynolds (secops lead) will be primary for the questionnaire; security@carecore.io can handle evidence uploads.

We can do Thursday 3/24 10:00 PT (works for Tom). I will try to send the SOC 2 cover letter and auditor contact by EOD tomorrow.

—
Maya Patel
Head of Risk & Compliance
CareCore Health
m.patel@carecore.io | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@carecore.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carecore.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2 status, scope and scheduling

Hi Maya / Tom — great to meet you virtually. A few clarifying technical questions ahead of the kickoff so we can prefill accurately: 

1) Encryption keys: Who manages KMS for the production DB and for object storage (CareCore-managed KMS vs. cloud provider KMS)? If customer-managed keys, which provider (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HSM)?
2) Data retention: What is the default retention for the tables containing PHI? Are there any backups retained beyond that window?
3) Network segmentation: Can you confirm whether inference traffic would traverse a separate VPC/subnet with restricted egress, or would Redwood integrate into existing VPCs? Any peering/VPN requirements we should note?
4) Service accounts: For evidence mapping, do you have a naming convention for service accounts and audit logs; if possible, provide the last 30 days of admin activity for the prod clusters (or point us to where they’ll drop evidence).

If you can answer 1–3 before the call, we’ll have most of the prefill done and should only need a short sync to confirm evidence paths. We’ll keep the prefill limited to the CAIQ baseline plus a two-item Redwood addendum (KV persistence and model weights retention).

Thanks — look forward to Thursday.

—
Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0274

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carecore.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@carecore.io>, CareCore Security Team <security@carecore.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2 status, scope and scheduling

Neha — thanks for the detailed list. Quick answers inline: 

1) KMS: We use AWS KMS with customer-managed CMKs for DB encryption (key alias arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-efgh). Object storage (S3) uses the same CMK.
2) Retention: PHI tables are retained 365 days by default; point-in-time snapshots exist for 90 days; backups to cold storage are retained 3 years for compliance reasons. We’ll mark which tables are subject to longer retention during evidence upload.
3) Network: Inference integrations would be on a dedicated VPC peered to our prod VPC with restrictive egress rules. We can share VPC CIDRs and peering docs ahead of the call.
4) Service accounts & logs: We will provide the admin activity logs for the last 30 days via a secure S3 bucket link (security@carecore.io will create share).

We’ll get the SOC 2 cover letter and auditor contact over to you by EOD today. See you on Thursday 3/24 10:00 PT.

—
Tom Reynolds
SecOps Lead
CareCore Health
tom.reynolds@carecore.io | +1 (617) 555-0123
